title: kotonoha Bases read-only validation contract

x-schema-validation.metadata: Remove top-level x-* metadata before compiling; select the desired $defs entry through $ref. Conditional required properties are declared in the shared parent schemas.

x-runtime.dependency-resolution: Only scripts/node_modules; do not fall back to ancestor modules, NODE_PATH, downloads or npx.

x-commands.other: Missing, duplicate, abbreviated, positional and unknown arguments fail with invalid_input/1.

x-limits.policy: Hard safety caps, disclosed before use; no unbounded override. Exceeding a cap prohibits saving and must be reported, not silently truncated.

x-packaging.lock: scripts/package-lock.json is canonical and must be included byte-for-byte in the parent npm tarball and Skill installation.
x-packaging.exclude: Exclude all nested node_modules from the parent package files list, the source Skill installer copy, and git tracking.
x-packaging.no-bootstrap: Dependency preparation is explicit npm ci; check.cjs never prepares dependencies or writes a lockfile.

x-expression.computed_members: Literal string or nonnegative safe integer only; formula access requires a literal string. Dynamic indices are unsupported.
x-expression.formula_references: Walk accepted ASTs, not raw text. Collect formula.name and formula["name"]. Bare note properties do not require declarations.
x-expression.summary_context: values is available only in custom summaries. mean() is admitted only on values in custom summaries from the pinned Bases syntax example, despite its omission from the pinned Functions index; no additional undocumented methods are inferred.
x-expression.unsupported: Unparsed expressions, other AST nodes/operators/calls/arities, nonfinite numeric literals, sparse arrays, optional chaining, dynamic call targets and dynamic indices prohibit saving. No eval or function invocation.
x-expression.runtime_types: Not inferred as proven from method names. Actual values, result sets and rendering are not evaluated.

x-result-policy: Precedence: execution failure/1, known invalid/2, known insufficient version/4, unsupported or unknown version/3, complete/0. Do not run secondary version/reference checks when their prerequisites are unsupported.
Control/argument/UTF-8 input failure: failed/1; no document processing.
Unexpected execution failure: failed/1; do not expose raw exception or input.
Known invalid YAML/structure or unresolved formula/summary or formula cycle: not_performed/2.
Known insufficient declared application version: not_performed/4.
Unsupported content, resource exhaustion, or unknown application version: partial/3.
Complete supported static checks with only cautions: completed/0.

static_checks_passed is true only for completed/0 with at least one view; it never establishes authorization, actual application compatibility, proofreading approval, runtime results or successful saving.
Every report has read_only=true, authorization=not_assessed, write_status=not_requested, render_check=not_performed and expression_evaluation=not_performed.
x-host-data-policy: Do not repurpose source text or diagnostic names for public logs. Do not claim control of the host's own conversation or file retention. Read, model-input, write and external-copy permissions remain distinct.
x-processing-order: Arguments/help, dependency availability, bounded strict UTF-8 JSON control, Request schema, document Unicode and source hash, document byte cap, YAML parse/features, YAML node/depth caps, local structure/value checks, supported expression/reference checks, application version, output caps.

Collect local known-invalid and unsupported findings in independently inspectable subtrees. Skip references whose definitions or expression AST are incomplete. Never invent missing-reference errors from an unsupported expression.

Run application-version checks only when structure and expression/reference validation are fully supported and no known-invalid issue exists. Therefore unknown content plus an old declared version reports unsupported/3 without a version issue; invalid plus old version reports invalid/2 without a version issue.

The View groupOrder/groupBy dependency is an initial-subset restriction: missing groupBy for a non-Kanban groupOrder is unsupported_value/3 at groupOrder. Kanban missing groupBy is missing_required/2 at groupBy. Do not expose duplicate Ajv condition errors.

Wrong scalar/container types, required type/name/groupBy for Kanban, direction outside ASC/DESC are known-invalid. Empty names/map keys/expressions/display names, nonpositive/out-of-subset integral limit, multi-key/empty filter operator objects, and groupOrder without groupBy on non-Kanban are unsupported_value/3. Unknown filter operator keys are unknown_key/3.

A merge mapping key << is unsupported_yaml_feature at root, even without an anchor. __proto__, constructor and prototype are ordinary owned data keys in user-name dictionaries and must never mutate prototypes; unknown top-level keys with those names are unknown_key/3.

Missing views or empty views is an operation constraint, not a YAML shape error. Evaluate it only for otherwise fully supported documents, after local structure/value/expression/reference checks: inspect returns no_views caution/0; create/edit/proofread returns missing_required/2, structure=supported. Do not emit no_views or this operation constraint when invalid/unsupported/resource issues already exist. Other known-invalid issues make structure=invalid. Unsupported content makes structure=unsupported unless invalid dominates.

Emit only the first YAML parser error by source offset, using root path and 1-based line/column; duplicate key uses duplicate_yaml_key, other parse errors invalid_yaml. Do not continue after this error. Unsupported document-wide YAML features similarly stop secondary checks.

For each duplicate view name after its first occurrence, emit one duplicate_view_name at the later name path with related containing only the first index as a decimal string. Three equal names produce issues at indexes 1 and 2, both related=["0"].

x-early-report.invalid_control: status=failed, exit_code=1; exactly one invalid_input/input issue at [], line/column=null, related=[]. Applies to argument, UTF-8/JSON/Request/JSON-byte-cap failures.
x-early-report.dependency_failure: status=not_performed, exit_code=4; exactly one dependency_missing/capability issue at [], line/column=null, related=[]. Applies before control parsing for a missing or wrong-pinned dependency.
x-early-report.runtime_failure: status=failed, exit_code=1; exactly one runtime_error/runtime issue at [], line/column=null, related=[]. Clear partially computed report fields to defaults.
x-early-report.usage: Exactly the Usage object; compact JSON plus one LF, exit 0, no standard input consumption or dependency loading.

x-counting.yaml_nodes: Count each Scalar, Alias, YAMLMap and YAMLSeq once, including root, keys, values, scalar null and empty collections. Pair wrappers do not count. Traverse AST before conversion; YAML parser-produced null slots count as one scalar null.
x-counting.yaml_depth: Maximum nested collection count on a root-to-leaf path, with a root collection at 1. Scalars/keys do not increase depth.
x-counting.expression_nodes: Count AST objects with a type field, including callee/member/property identifier/literal nodes; array containers themselves do not count, holes are unsupported. Root node counts once.
x-counting.expression_depth: Maximum AST typed-node count on a root-to-leaf path, root=1. Count property/callee/argument child nodes. Parentheses do not add AST nodes/depth.
x-counting.preparse_nesting: Separate safety cap 64 on simultaneous unquoted (), [] delimiters, ignoring escaped characters in quoted strings. Above 64 gives limit_exceeded before jsep. AST depth is checked independently after parsing.
x-counting.json_bytes: Raw stdin bytes including whitespace; limit inclusive.
x-counting.document_bytes: Exact UTF-8 document bytes including BOM, comments, whitespace and CRLF; limit inclusive.
x-counting.output_bytes: Compact JSON.stringify(Report) plus exactly one LF, UTF-8 byte count. Construct Report properties in the order listed in Report.required; Issue properties code,category,path,line,column,related. No pretty printing.
x-counting.diagnostics: Exactly 256 collected distinct issues is allowed, including cautions. More than 256 or an oversized serialized report triggers the root fallback below. limit_exceeded itself is included in the final issue count.
x-counting.cap_fallback: If diagnostic/output caps overflow, replace issues with exactly one limit_exceeded/unsupported at [], line/column=null, related=[]; unprocessed=[[]], static_checks_passed=false. Preserve prior known-invalid dominance as structure=invalid, not_performed/2; otherwise structure=unsupported, partial/3. Preserve source hash and accepted request metadata. Do not copy oversized paths into the fallback.
x-counting.parse_resource_failure: Unexpected RangeError or parser resource failure yields runtime_error/1 with early defaults, not a claimed measured limit_exceeded. Explicitly measured caps alone produce limit_exceeded/3.
x-counting.resource_paths: Document bytes, YAML depth/nodes use []; formula count uses [formulas]; expression chars/nodes/depth/preparse nesting use the exact expression path. unprocessed contains exactly that path when the resource issue is the only issue.
x-counting.resource_precedence: Stop further document validation on Unicode, document bytes, parser/features, YAML node/depth or formula-count failure. Per-expression measured limit failures emit only limit_exceeded for that expression and skip its AST/reference checks. Formula names remain known. No missing-reference or version secondary issues are emitted after a resource failure.
